relations: The fixed canister body and trailing cord anchor the scene while the rigid wand connects to the moving floor nozzle.
As the nozzle glides toward and away from the camera, the wand tilts slightly forward and back to follow.
Thin white vapor swirls around the canister and nozzle, reshaping continuously without disturbing the yellowish patch on the tile.
The motion ends with the nozzle lifting off the tile, breaking contact while the canister and hose remain stationary.
caption: The video showcases a canister-style vacuum cleaner resting on a pale speckled tile floor, its glossy dark-maroon body, spoked wheel, trailing cord and coiled black hose holding steady in the frame. A rigid metal wand descends from the body to a wide floor nozzle fitted with two light-grey side wings. This nozzle head glides repeatedly toward and away from the camera along the tile surface, producing a back-and-forth cleaning motion that leaves several frames streaked with horizontal blur. As the head translates, the wand tilts slightly forward and back, and the nozzle swells closer in some moments and recedes smaller in others. A faint yellowish patch sits on the floor in the foreground, unmoved by the body's fixed position. Thin white vapor hangs around the canister and puffs near the nozzle throughout, swirling and reshaping its outline from frame to frame. The motion belongs entirely to the wand and nozzle assembly, while the canister, wheel, cord and hose remain fixed relative to the stable framing. The excerpt closes with the nozzle raised and tilted up off the tile.
